name: Bank of India Flexi Cap Fund

key_facts.Current NAV: The Current Net Asset Value of the Bank of India Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan as of Aug 14, 2026 is Rs 42.57 for Growth option of its Direct plan.
key_facts.Fund Size: The Bank of India Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan currently holds Assets under Management worth of Rs 2786.4 crore as on Jul 31, 2026.
key_facts.Expense ratio: The expense ratio of the fund is 0.86% for Direct plan as on Aug 14, 2026.
key_facts.Exit Load: Bank of India Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan shall attract an Exit Load, "Exit Load for units in excess of 10% of the investment,1% will be charged for redemption within 3 months."
key_facts.Minimum Investment: Minimum investment required is Rs 5000 and minimum additional investment is Rs 1000. Minimum SIP investment is Rs 1000.

performance.Trailing/Category Returns: Its trailing returns over different time periods are: 17.21% (1yr), 22.19% (3yr), 18.01% (5yr) and 26.66% (since launch). Whereas, Category returns for the same time duration are: 5.98% (1yr), 13.11% (3yr) and 11.49% (5yr).

objective: Investment Objective - The scheme seeks to generate long term capital appreciation by investing predominantly in equity and equity-related securities across various market capitalisation.
